commit 174e252d47c66e87d8a6538a8cbc4a19c3847889
Author:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Aug 17 19:07:50 2026 +0100
Commit:     brendan@thunderbird.net <brendan@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Aug 19 10:26:19 2026 +0000

    Bug 2058787 - Follow-up, Tagging should use 'comm_head_rev' for thunderbird. r=coreycb,tobyp
    
    Landoscript is pulling the version directly from {head_rev} and ignores the prefix
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D318947

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml
index cfd19229f47..afe059a466b 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-early-tagging/kind.yml
@@ -17,13 +17,12 @@ task-defaults:
     shipping-phase: promote
     task-context:
         from-parameters:
-            head_rev: head_rev
+            head_rev: comm_head_rev
         substitution-fields:
             - worker.actions
     worker-type: lando
     worker:
         implementation: scriptworker-lando
-        repo-param-prefix: comm_
         lando-repo:
             by-project:
                 comm-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
index 508a987621e..b2ff2ee25e4 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-version-bump/kind.yml
@@ -20,13 +20,12 @@ task-defaults:
     shipping-phase: ship
     task-context:
         from-parameters:
-            head_rev: head_rev
+            head_rev: comm_head_rev
         substitution-fields:
             - worker.actions
     worker-type: lando
     worker:
         implementation: scriptworker-lando
-        repo-param-prefix: comm_
         lando-repo:
             by-project:
                 comm-beta: thunderbird-desktop-beta
title: Bug 2058787 - Follow-up, Tagging should use 'comm_head_rev' for thunderbird. r=coreycb,tobyp
